home.tagline: Studying God's Word together, sharing the hope of His coming Kingdom and rooted in agape Love.
home.aboutBody: The Bangalore Bible Students are a non-denominational Christian fellowship devoted to the careful study of the entire Bible — Old and New Testaments alike — as the inspired word of God. We accept Jesus Christ as our Redeemer, whose ransom sacrifice opens the way for God's promised Kingdom to bless all the families of the earth. There is no membership to join, no creed to sign, and no clergy to follow: each of us is encouraged to study the Scriptures personally and prove all things for ourselves. Our gatherings are simple, warm, and rooted in prayer and fellowship, and all are welcome to study God's Word together with us.
